AI Firm Anthropic Eyes Up to $1.4 Trillion Valuation in IPO

Artificial intelligence company Anthropic is targeting a valuation of up to $1.4 trillion for its upcoming initial public offering (IPO). The company aims to raise between $64 billion and $90.4 billion through the listing, according to various reports. Initial expectations for the IPO valuation had been as high as $2 trillion, but this figure has reportedly been adjusted downwards. The IPO is seen as a test of investor enthusiasm for artificial intelligence companies.
